finding.title: Existing subject hashes cannot bind uncommitted implementation content
finding.body:
Task 3 explicitly reuses existing gate hashes, but receipt/hash.js subjectHash covers task/phase/gate, plan/design hashes, base/head SHAs and round—not working-tree content. The implement review invocation in commands/prp-implement.md does not require a committed snapshot. Consequently, an edit after review that leaves HEAD and the plan unchanged can retain the same subject hash; the proposed evidence checks cannot distinguish reviewed code from changed code. This undermines the claimed current-subject binding even when Claude genuinely returned approval.
INTENT: UI3
finding.recommendation: Define a separate reviewed-content digest covering staged, unstaged and relevant untracked content, or require an immutable committed review target. Capture it before invocation and verify it before sealing and reuse. Preserve legacy subject hashes, and add a regression where implementation content changes without changing HEAD or the plan.
